# Description of Changes

## Risk level: High

This is a high risk change because it requires consumers to substantially change their code. This includes renaming and removing features, changing function signatures significantly, changes to the package's entrypoints, and anything in general that would require users to migrate their code to adopt the changes. It must pass the CI checks in order for changes to be merged and deployed.

## Type of Change

The type of changes made can be found on the labels associated with the pull request. The exact changes made can be found under the commits tab.
